title: The Puppet That Kept Splitting
story: In the dusty theater under the town hall, Vexlimb the Marionette Fiend splits into 3 smaller puppets every time a sword touches its strings. Mr 6 counts 2 puppets on stage and knows a careless knight would swing 4 times, each swing hitting exactly one puppet.
question: If each swing turns one puppet into 3, how many puppets would be dancing after 4 swings?
hint: Each swing removes one puppet and adds three — so the crowd grows by 2 every swing. Start from 2.
victory: Mr 6 sheathes his sword, hands Vexlimb a pair of scissors, and points out that four swings only meant ten dance partners. The puppet, delighted, cuts its own strings and joins the town theater troupe.
imagePrompt: A tangle of grinning wooden marionettes splitting apart on a candlelit theater stage, while a small number-six knight thoughtfully keeps his sword sheathed.
solution: Each swing turns 1 puppet into 3, so the crowd grows by 3 - 1 = 2 puppets.
Starting from 2 puppets, 4 swings add 4 × 2 = 8 puppets.
praise: Noticing the puppets multiply was good thinking — the missing step was that only one puppet splits per swing, so the crowd grows by 2 each time instead of tripling.
